mode: academic editorial analogy; no generated technical labels
sharedConstraints: restrained navy, slate, off-white and teal palette
no readable words, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, logos or code
no cartoon, toy, clay, childish, glossy icon or playful-poster style
image establishes an analogy only; exact facts are supplied by reviewed HTML, code, tables and image transcripts

assets.prompt: Academic institutional archive for data representation and compression: full text, photographic image, sound waveform and geometric drawing plans beside compact archival cases; exact-copy preservation route contrasted with perceptual simplification; no technical labels.
assets.reviewNotes: Mature archival metaphor; any small paper marks are unreadable and carry no technical claim. Page copy states the exact lossless/lossy boundary.

assets.prompt: Professional automated greenhouse research facility with sensors, a central control cabinet, physical ventilation/irrigation/shading actuators and a separate monitoring-only observation station; academic architectural cutaway; no labels.
assets.reviewNotes: Credible monitoring/control setting. Exact sensor types, actuator actions and feedback directions remain in HTML.

assets.prompt: Disciplined industrial operations-room analogy for processor architecture: ordered archive, central coordinator, distinct conduits, calculation workbench, clock and nearby high-speed staging shelf; not a literal CPU schematic; no labels.
assets.reviewNotes: No register or bus value is asserted by the picture. Exact architecture is taught by reviewed diagrams and register-transfer traces.

assets.prompt: Professional engineering production studio where human-readable plans pass through translation and inspection stations, reusable components feed the build and a finished artefact leaves; system-software analogy; no literal code or phase labels.
assets.reviewNotes: Mature production metaphor. The page explicitly limits the analogy and supplies the actual assembler/compiler/interpreter mechanisms.

assets.prompt: Credible institutional records facility with reception identity checkpoint, controlled inner doorway, compartmented records rooms, locked cabinets and a physically separate backup vault; architecture alone suggests defence in depth; no overlays or icons.
assets.reviewNotes: Replacement candidate contains no floating security icons or invented data paths. The technical role of each digital control is supplied outside the image.

assets.prompt: Formal technology review chamber with engineers, legal and public-interest representatives examining authorship, permission, public benefit, risk and environmental cost; balanced academic policy-journal scene; no text or robot cliché.
assets.reviewNotes: Stakeholder-review metaphor only; the page requires evidence-led ethical and licensing justification.

assets.prompt: Professional research archive moving from duplicate loose folders to a disciplined central catalogue with related collections, controlled access and a separate backup; no literal ER diagram, keys or readable cards.
assets.reviewNotes: The physical archive is explicitly bounded from tables, keys, normal forms and SQL.

assets.prompt: Professional urban-planning studio decomposing a complex transport problem across abstraction, input-process-output, decisions, repeated patterns and progressive refinement; plans deliberately unreadable; no exact flowchart claim.
assets.reviewNotes: Maps contain no readable labels. Exact flowchart and pseudocode conventions are rendered separately.

assets.prompt: Serious research archive showing physical analogies for a one-ended tray tower, orderly waiting line, linked movable containers, uniform drawer grid and multi-field case folders; not a technical ADT diagram; no labels.
assets.reviewNotes: The objects do not define LIFO/FIFO/link behaviour. Those rules and operations are explicitly stated in page components.

assets.prompt: Disciplined scientific analysis laboratory separating a complex job into reusable action and value-producing modules with input and result trays whose returned results are combined centrally; no code or syntax labels.
assets.reviewNotes: The visual only introduces modularity. Procedure/function interfaces and return semantics are provided by complete pseudocode.

assets.prompt: Professional engineering assurance laboratory with requirement analysis, design modelling, implementation, systematic test, fault diagnosis, acceptance and maintenance zones plus prototypes at different maturity; no lifecycle arrows or labels.
assets.reviewNotes: The scene does not impose a lifecycle order. Waterfall, iterative and RAD choices are taught in the adjacent comparison.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Rejected before use: uncontrolled floating icons, dotted paths and network overlays could be read as technical relationships not established by the prompt.
